sloka: तस्यैवं वचनं श्रुत्वा धर्मराजः प्रतापवान् ।अब्रवीत्तत्र तं मुत्युं त्वं तिष्ठैनं निहन्म्यहम् ।। ७.२२.३२ ॥
transliteration: tasyaivaṁ vacanaṁ śrutvā dharmarājaḥ pratāpavān ।abravīttatra taṁ mutyuṁ tvaṁ tiṣṭhainaṁ nihanmyaham ।। 7.22.32 ॥

translations.english: This is not merely my strength, but a natural rule that anyone seen by me does not live even for a moment.
